action_semantics: explicit uncertainty with partial task credit
inherited_task.cost_units: Declared task-utility charges, including stochastic channel charge inside the outcome expectation. CPU and wall nanoseconds reported separately, no energy claim.
inherited_task.interval_scope: Two prespecified paired synthetic-episode comparisons, each 97.5 percent percentile-bootstrap interval; not natural-source or training-seed population coverage
inherited_task.media: Deterministic semantic codecs: text, PNG, PCM tone WAV, uncompressed AVI. Audio is not speech; video is a finite moving marker, not learned natural video.
primary_comparisons: risk_numeric versus mean_numeric on empirical CE
risk_numeric versus risk_zero on mean net return
inherited_task.repair_channel: One registered reliable retransmission; generated and read back anew; no hidden-target acquisition
inherited_task.reward_visibility: Only public delivery consistency feedback before continuation. Hidden target enters private score after final action and receipt have been persisted.
inherited_task.scope: New synthetic finite mechanism study, not a replay or confirmation of V6, not natural multimodal learning, not production owner integration
inherited_task.shuffle_control: Permutes the scalar feedback across evaluation episodes; exact scalar marginal retained
inherited_task.stopping_rule: One registered run, all rows/faults and negative comparisons retained; no parameter search using evaluation targets
inherited_task.strong_control: risk_history receives identical complete public delivery readback and chooses repair from its registered consequences; no unique numeric advantage is presumed
inherited_task.training_claim: Actual numpy gradient updates of a 4x3 categorical posterior and a two-parameter numeric-feedback policy. Media encoders/decoders are deterministic and untrained.

protocol.head_features: intercept + ten second-tick activation values + ten second-tick eligibility values, each Q24 scaled
protocol.head_training_label: Actual target-free paired delivered repair gain positive, before/after artifacts both reopened
protocol.history_control: Same public readback and native/head compute; registered direct mismatch-penalty versus repair-cost decision; numeric superiority is not presumed
protocol.inherited_task: Frozen risk_feedback/PROTOCOL.json and evidence/PARAMETERS.json, file hashes registered before fresh outcomes
protocol.initial_action: Risk profile using the previously trained categorical posterior; identical for all five arms
protocol.interval_scope: Synthetic paired episode draws conditional on one trained head; two prespecified primary comparisons, no training-seed or natural-source population inference
protocol.kernel: Exact original sparse_tick, fixed width10/top_k2/config; no kernel parameter updates
protocol.media_scope: Actual UTF8 text, PNG, tone PCM WAV, and uncompressed AVI semantic codecs; not learned natural speech/video
primary_comparisons: numeric minus zero mean net return
numeric minus state_reset mean net return
protocol.private_target_visibility: Only private scoring after final file receipt; never passed to native request or continuation readout
protocol.scalar_path: Readback-derived scalar -> two-channel fixed drive -> first sparse_tick checkpoint -> zero-drive second sparse_tick -> activation and eligibility only -> fitted readout -> repair or stop
protocol.scope: Fresh synthetic mechanism intervention on exact original sparse_tick, not original Agentd qualification or a full NDU training claim
protocol.shared_budget: Every arm gets two real sparse_tick calls, one common frozen trained head, same public readback, at most two delivered four-file bundles; realized repair cost and native/wall time reported separately
protocol.shuffle_control: All first bundles are delivered and read back before shuffling actual committed numeric feedback across cases; exactly preserved empirical scalar marginal
protocol.state_reset_intervention: Numeric first tick executes, then its checkpoint is discarded; second tick starts from None with zero drive. Both native calls still execute. This is an explicit research intervention, never a production reset.
protocol.stopping_rule: One fresh registered run; retain negative controls and all episodes; no evaluation-driven head/kernel tuning
